title: xDrip (with Libre 1 + MiaoMiao2 + Huawei Honor 8A) can't connect BT
symptom: After updating xDrip to Nightly build 4th Sep 2020, the app stops connecting to the Bluetooth device. It gets stuck at 'Attempting connection' and the status shows 'Not connected'. The BT device status always shows 'Next Wake up: 5 мин'.
evidence_quote: I updated xDrip to Nightly build 4th Sep 2020 and it stopped to connect.
